source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Except in the first [battle round](vsdata:core-rule/the-battle-round), in [your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) you can pick a **NECRONS INFANTRY** unit of yours that is on the battlefield or in [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves). If it is on the battlefield, take it off and put it in Strategic Reserves.

It can then make an [ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move). In that move, it must be set up **unengaged** and wholly within 6" of the Monolith, in place of the usual need to be more than 8" away, measured horizontally, from every enemy unit, even inside the enemy deployment zone.

It can make no [Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move) for the rest of the turn.

detail.timing: own Movement phase, excluding battle round one
detail.ifOnBattlefield: remove unit and put into Strategic Reserves
